variables.solutionDescription: Provides real-time active deception telemetry, honeypot breach intelligence, and zero-trust gateway threat analytics from DECTRAX into Microsoft Sentinel.

uiConfig.title: DECTRAX Active Deception & Threat Intelligence
uiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The **DECTRAX Solution for Microsoft Sentinel** provides automated continuous ingestion of high-fidelity threat intelligence, honeypot breach indicators, and GATE zero-trust gateway blocks directly into your Log Analytics workspace.

sampleQueries.description: High Severity Threats in Last 24 Hours
sampleQueries.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where toint(Severity_d) >= 7 or toint(Severity_s) >= 7
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s, DestinationPort_d, Protocol_s, Signature_s, Severity_s, Platform_s

sampleQueries.description: Top Attacker IPs targeted across DECTRAX Deception Mesh
sampleQueries.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| summarize AttackCount = count(), UniquePorts = dcount(DestinationPort_d), Signatures = make_set(Signature_s) by SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s
| sort by AttackCount desc

dataTypes.name: DECTRAXThreats_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
DECTRAXThreats_CL | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value: DECTRAXThreats_CL | summarize LastLog = max(TimeGenerated) | project IsConnected = LastLog > ago(3d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Obtain DECTRAX API Token
instructionSteps.description: Log into your **DECTRAX Admin Console**, navigate to **Settings > Integrations > SIEM & SOAR Pipelines**, and copy your dedicated Bearer API Token.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Verify Real-time Ingestion
instructionSteps.description: Once configured, Microsoft Sentinel will poll the DECTRAX Threat Intelligence feed at regular intervals. Events will populate the `DECTRAXThreats_CL` table and can be queried using KQL or viewed in the prebuilt Workbook.

properties.displayName: DECTRAX - High Severity Honeypot Breach Detected
properties.description: Identifies critical exploitation attempts, unauthorized shell breakouts, or high-severity attacks intercepted by DECTRAX active deception honeypot sensors.
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where toint(Severity_d) >= 8 or toint(Severity_s) >= 8 or Signature_s has_any ('RCE', 'Exploit', 'Breakout', 'Rootkit', 'Unauthorized Access', 'Privilege Escalation')
| extend IPCustomEntity = coalesce(SourceIP_s, tostring(column_ifexists('ip_s', '')))
| extend HostCustomEntity = coalesce(NodeID_s, tostring(column_ifexists('node_id_s', '')))
| extend ProtocolCustom = coalesce(Protocol_s, tostring(column_ifexists('protocol_s', '')))
| extend PortCustom = coalesce(tostring(DestinationPort_d), tostring(column_ifexists('port_d', '')))
| project TimeGenerated, IPCustomEntity, HostCustomEntity, ProtocolCustom, PortCustom, Signature_s, Severity_s, SourceCountry_s, SourceCity_s, URL_s, Platform_s

properties.description: Detects automated adversary scanners probing multiple honeypot sensors or targeting multiple distinct network ports across the DECTRAX deception mesh.
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize DistinctPorts = dcount(DestinationPort_d), DistinctNodes = dcount(NodeID_s), TotalAttempts = count(), Signatures = make_set(Signature_s, 5) by SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where DistinctPorts >= 5 or TotalAttempts >= 20
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP_s

properties.displayName: DECTRAX - GATE Zero-Trust Threat & Injection Intercepted
properties.description: Detects SQL injection, OS command injection, XSS, or prompt injection payloads intercepted and blocked by the DECTRAX GATE edge reverse proxy.
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where Platform_s =~ 'GATE' or Signature_s has_any ('SQL Injection', 'Command Injection', 'XSS', 'Prompt Injection', 'Schema Violation', 'BMS Override')
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP_s
| extend URLCustomEntity = URL_s
| project TimeGenerated, IPCustomEntity, URLCustomEntity, Signature_s, Method_s, SourceCountry_s, NodeID_s

properties.displayName: DECTRAX - Critical SCADA / BMS / IoT Protocol Tampering
properties.description: Detects unauthorized connection attempts or command injections targeting Modbus, BACnet, S7comm, MQTT, or BMS/IoT industrial control protocols.
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where Protocol_s in~ ('modbus', 'bacnet', 's7comm', 'dnp3', 'mqtt', 'coap') or DestinationPort_d in (502, 47808, 102, 20000, 1883, 5683)
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP_s
| extend HostCustomEntity = NodeID_s
| project TimeGenerated, IPCustomEntity, HostCustomEntity, Protocol_s, DestinationPort_d, Signature_s, Severity_s, SourceCountry_s

properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| extend EventVendor = 'DECTRAX', EventProduct = 'DECTRAX', EventProductVersion = '1.0'
| extend EventStartTime = TimeGenerated, EventEndTime = TimeGenerated
| extend EventType = 'ThreatIntel', EventSeverity = tostring(coalesce(Severity_s, tostring(Severity_d), 'Medium'))
| extend SrcIpAddr = coalesce(SourceIP_s, tostring(column_ifexists('ip_s', '')))
| extend SrcGeoCountry = coalesce(SourceCountry_s, tostring(column_ifexists('country_s', '')))
| extend SrcGeoCity = coalesce(SourceCity_s, tostring(column_ifexists('city_s', '')))
| extend DstPortNumber = toint(coalesce(DestinationPort_d, toint(column_ifexists('port_d', 0))))
| extend NetworkProtocol = coalesce(Protocol_s, tostring(column_ifexists('protocol_s', '')))
| extend ThreatSignature = coalesce(Signature_s, tostring(column_ifexists('signature_s', '')))
| extend TargetNodeId = coalesce(NodeID_s, tostring(column_ifexists('node_id_s', '')))
| extend TargetUrl = coalesce(URL_s, tostring(column_ifexists('url_s', '')))
| extend HttpMethod = coalesce(Method_s, tostring(column_ifexists('method_s', '')))
| extend RawPayload = coalesce(Payload_s, tostring(column_ifexists('payload_s', '')))
| extend IngestionPlatform = coalesce(Platform_s, 'DECTRAX')

properties.displayName: DECTRAX - SSH Deception Brute Force Hunting
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where Protocol_s =~ 'ssh' or DestinationPort_d == 22
| summarize AttemptCount = count(), NodeCount = dcount(NodeID_s), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s
| where AttemptCount > 10
| sort by AttemptCount desc

properties.displayName: DECTRAX - Zero-Day & Web Shell Exploitation Hunting
properties.query:
DECTRAXThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
| where Signature_s has_any ('log4j', 'spring4shell', 'cve-', 'webshell', 'cmd.exe', '/bin/sh', 'curl', 'wget')
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP_s, SourceCountry_s, DestinationPort_d, Protocol_s, Signature_s, Method_s, URL_s, NodeID_s
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
